text: From Rwanda the coltan ships on to smelters in China, Kazakhstan and Thailand. Global Witness found it may have unwittingly reached global electronics brands.

source.name: Global Witness
source.quote: Most of these shipments go to smelters in China, with a share going to Kazakhstan and, until the end of 2023, to Thailand.

additionalSources.name: SWI swissinfo.ch, 'UN experts warn Congo's conflict minerals slipping into global market' (citing UN Group of Experts on the DRC)
additionalSources.quote: The smuggling of minerals from eastern DRC into neighboring Rwanda has reached unprecedented levels
